mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM business_partner WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
AND ( LOWER(partner_code) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(partner_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR business_number LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND supplier_yn = 'Y'
AND customer_yn = 'Y'
AND use_yn = #{useYn}
ORDER BY use_yn DESC, partner_name ASC, partner_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_partner ( company_id, partner_code, partner_name, business_number, representative_name, contact_name, phone, email, postal_code, address1, address2, supplier_yn, customer_yn, use_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{partnerCode}, #{partnerName}, #{businessNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{contactName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{postalCode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, #{supplierYn}, #{customerYn}, #{useYn}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
